standard_prerequisites.name: A closed immersion is affine, and affineness descends along an fpqc covering
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, Lemma morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion-affine and Same chapter, Lemma lemma-descending-property-affine, invoked at proof lines 6195-6198
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes f affine, so that the remaining question is surjectivity of a sheaf map.

standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, invoked at proof lines 6202-6204
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the pushforward along the base change with the pullback of f_* O_X.

core_obligations: Assume each base change f_i is a closed immersion, hence affine, and descend affineness to f (proof lines 6191-6198).
Reduce the remaining claim to surjectivity of O_Y -> f_* O_X (proof lines 6198-6199).
For a point y, pick i and y_i over y and use flat base change to identify f_{i,*}(O_{Y_i x_Y X}) with the pullback of f_* O_X (proof lines 6200-6205).
Tensor the stalk map up to O_{Y_i,y_i} and use faithful flatness to conclude surjectivity at y (proof lines 6206-6216).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to surjectivity of the structure map (proof lines 6198-6199).
Stalkwise verification via flat base change and faithful flatness (proof lines 6200-6216).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property 'f is a closed immersion' is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6184-6188). The proof reduces the two constituents separately: closed immersions are affine, so descent of affineness makes f affine; it then remains to show that O_Y -> f_* O_X is surjective, and this is checked stalkwise: for a point y the covering supplies i and y_i over y, flat base change identifies f_{i,*}(O_{Y_i x_Y X}) with the pullback of f_* O_X, the assumption makes it a quotient of O_{Y_i}, and surjectivity of the map after tensoring up to the faithfully flat local ring O_{Y_i,y_i} forces surjectivity at y (proof lines 6190-6216). The level is H3: the reduction to stalks and the use of faithful flatness of the local ring extension is a genuine local computation, displayed in full.
